description: My fellow residents, small business owners, and neighbors across District 49: I’m Long David Liu.Every single day, you wake up, work hard, pay your taxes, and play by the rules. But look at what’s happening around us. Our streets are getting less safe. Our small businesses are struggling just to keep their doors open. Our families are being shut out of decisions that belong to parents—not Sacramento. And our elections still ask honest citizens to trust a system that refuses basic voter ID.Mike F
title: We Debate. You Decide.
